claim: D-024: complete writers overwrite their cell (only sparse writers CAS-merge).

ver_note: The D-024 annotation of 2026-10-13 (log.md:1018-1021) records D-104's one policy: no writer overwrites.

claim: D-024: the CAS retry is bounded by drain interception.
